newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Cargolux sees continued growth in charter.
newsitem.headline: Cargolux sees continued growth in charter.

text.p: All-cargo airline, Cargolux Airlines International, said the strong growth in its charter flight activity in 1996 is set to continue in 1997.
"Last year, we operated 267 charter flights - comprising regular, ad hoc and sub-charter - an increase of 87 percent on 1995," Cargolux's charter division director, Lucien Huesmann told Reuters.
He said strong growth was largely down to a major contract with Swiss forwarding group, Panalpina, which took effect in August 1996 and covers a three-year period.
"Last year's charter flight figures only incorporated several months of the Panalpina contract whereas in 1997 its impact will be felt over the whole term," Huesmann added.

The Panalpina contract currently generated four to five Boeing 747F frequencies per week carrying IBM parts from Europe to the U.S. - Bradley, Huntsville and Miami and Mexico - Mexico City and Guadalajara.
Another regular charter route to develop last year was from Accra in Ghana carrying pineapple shipments, Huesmann said.
The round-year service was launched in July 1996 and operates to a weekly frequency and occasionally involves two or three weekly frequencies.
Cargolux's 1997 charter activity has also been boosted by flights operated on behalf of Formula One motor racing organisation, FOCA, he added.

"Earlier this year, we operated several flights for the Grand Prix in Brazil and Argentina - Stansted to Sao Paulo on to Buenos Aires and from there to Milan. Currently we are in discussions with FOCA for the Japanese Grand Prix in October.
"It had been some time since we worked with the FOCA mainly due to the availability of our aircraft. A race in an inter-continental destination outside Europe requires the capacity of six jumbos."
Cargolux operates a fleet of three Boeing 747-400Fs and is to take delivery of a further two 400Fs in August and November this year.
It also operates four Boeing 747-200Fs, including one on leaseback. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
